Curaçao is likely to adopt a 4-3-3 formation, a setup that allows them to balance defensive solidity with attacking flair. Coach Fred Rutten is expected to emphasize a compact defensive structure, utilizing the strengths of central defenders like Juninho Albertus and Jurensley Martina. The full-backs, Brandley Deeke and Rangelo Room, will be tasked with providing width and supporting the attack. In midfield, the presence of a holding midfielder like Juninho Jansen will be crucial in breaking up opposition play and initiating counter-attacks. Offensively, Curaçao will rely on quick transitions, with wingers Eloy Albertus and Jurensley Jansen providing pace and creativity on the flanks. The central striker, likely Brandley Albertus, will be the focal point of their attack, aiming to capitalize on crosses and through balls.

results.title: Germany vs Curacao Match Preview, Prediction, Timings, Lineups, Teams, and How to Watch — FIFA World Cup 2026
highlights:
## Team News & Predicted Lineups
[...]
Germany head in on a stunning nine-match winning run, having beaten Finland 4–0 and the USA 2–1 in their World Cup warm-ups. Julian Nagelsmann has confirmed veteran goalkeeper Manuel Neuer (40) starts despite recent calf issues. Nathaniel Brown has edged ahead of David Raum at left-back, and Felix Nmecha is set to partner Aleksandar Pavlović in midfield. The attacking quartet of Florian Wirtz, Jamal Musiala, Leroy Sané, and Kai Havertz is genuinely frightening.
[...]
Curaçao arrive as proud World Cup debutants with no fresh injury concerns. Captain Leandro Bacuna and Tahith Chong (Sheffield United) are their standout names in a squad largely drawn from the Dutch football system.
[...]
| Team | Predicted XI |
| --- | --- |
| Germany | Neuer; Kimmich, Tah, Rüdiger, N. Brown; Pavlović, Nmecha; Sané, Musiala, Wirtz; Havertz |
| Curaçao | Room; Gaari, Obispo, Floranus; Sambo, Comenencia, L. Bacuna, J. Bacuna; Chong, Kastaneer, Gorre |
[...]
Germany are overwhelming favourites — and rightly so. Their front four alone has the quality to dismantle far better defences than Curaçao’s. Expect a high-scoring, one-sided affair, though Curaçao’s organised low block could delay the inevitable early on.
[...]
Prediction: Germany 4–0 Curaçao

results.title: Dreaming of an Upset: Curaçao 2026 World Cup Preview - VAVEL International
highlights:
The North American nation will be hoping for another upset in this year’s World Cup, with the help of a pool of Dutch-born talents such as brothers Leandro and Juninho Bacuna, Jurgen Locadia, and Armando Obispo.
[...]
Throughout qualifying Advocaat deployed a classic Dutch 4-3-3, with 22-year-old Livano Comenencia lying deep in midfield to allow for the midfield and fullbacks to push forward.
[...]
It would be expected for the Blue Wave to set up with a low-to-mid defensive block, with a focus on off-the-ball organisation in an attempt to be as hard to score against as possible.
[...]
A creative flair might be present within the side, with players such as the aforementioned Bacuna brothers and Tahith Chong acting as attacking threats who could pose a danger on the counter-attack.
[...]
What we know for sure is that the Little General will not stand for any nonsense across the tournament and will have his players organised and on a strict regime.
[...]
## Player to watch – Leandro Bacuna
[...]
Leandro Bacuna is the captain and the joint most-capped player of his national team alongside goalkeeper Eloy Room with 71 caps each.
[...]
The former Cardiff player only missed one game in qualifying and will be a key
[...]
in any build-up play.
[...]
The midfielder is also the set-piece taker, meaning he will most likely be in and around the goals his country manage to score – as their lack of quality in comparison to other nations could lead to the majority of their goals coming from dead-ball opportunities.
[...]
The Blue Wave have not been handed the group they may have been hoping for, with Group E also containing Ecuador, Ivory Coast, and Germany.
